name: Visual Studio
note: Visual Studio 2022, General Development profile, from the Microsoft Learn "Keyboard shortcuts in Visual Studio" reference (Popular, Global and Context-specific tables). Menu groups in the Global tables are recorded with an empty context; Debug and the panel/context-menu tables keep their name as the context, as do all Context-specific tables. Where Microsoft lists several bindings for one command the first expressible one is kept. Omitted because the chord grammar cannot express them: everything using the Break key (Build.Cancel Ctrl+Break, Debug.BreakAll Ctrl+Alt+Break, F# Interactive Ctrl+Break, the four SSDT/Query "stop" commands Alt+Break) and everything using a numpad key (Azure Ctrl+Num *, Ctrl+R and Ctrl+Num *, Ctrl+D; Debug.ShowNextStatement Alt+Num *; Class diagram Collapse/Expand Num -/Num +; Workflow Designer Zoom in/out Ctrl+Num +/Ctrl+Num -). Graphics Diagnostics "Capture frame" and Text Editor "Select current word" are listed by Microsoft as "None". Commands documented only for Visual Studio 2019 or 2017 (Build selection, Function breakpoint, Surround with) are left out. Three labels name two different commands ("Open file", "Navigate backward", "Navigate forward", also "Rename"); the second one carries its menu name as context.
